contracts.title: Master Cloud & SaaS Services Agreement 2026
contracts.extractedText: Sample Master Cloud & SaaS Agreement 2026 containing SLAs, Notice Windows, Security Obligations and Data Handling Terms.

pages.textContent: This Master Cloud Services Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into by and between Acme Cloud Solutions ("Supplier") and Enterprise Corp ("Client").
Supplier shall undergo an Annual Cyber Risk Assessment Audit within 45 days of the start of each calendar fiscal year.
Either party may terminate this agreement without cause by providing at least 60 days prior written notice prior to the expiration of the term.

deadlines.title: Annual Cyber Risk Assessment Audit
deadlines.description: Supplier must submit third-party SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 audit report.
deadlines.deadlineText: Within 45 days of fiscal year start
deadlines.evidenceText: Supplier shall undergo an Annual Cyber Risk Assessment Audit within 45 days of fiscal year start.

deadlines.title: Q2 Vulnerability Remediation Report
deadlines.description: Vendor mandatory submission of critical vulnerability patch verification.
deadlines.evidenceText: Vendor must provide critical vulnerability patch report no later than 15 days following quarter end.

deadlines.title: Initial Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA)
deadlines.description: Submission of GDPR Article 35 risk assessment report.
deadlines.evidenceText: Data Processor shall complete and deliver the DPIA prior to processing customer PII.

deadlines.title: MSA Contract Non-Renewal Written Notice Window
deadlines.description: Advance notice deadline to opt out of automatic 1-year contract extension.
deadlines.deadlineText: At least 60 days prior to contract expiration date
deadlines.evidenceText: Either party may prevent automatic renewal by providing written non-renewal notice at least 60 days prior.

deadlines.title: Discontinued Service Data Migration & Purge Phase-Out
deadlines.description: Permanent deletion of legacy data upon service transition.
deadlines.deadlineText: Upon mutually agreed phase-out schedule following transition
deadlines.evidenceText: Purge shall occur upon mutually agreed phase-out schedule following transition completion.

policies.title: Data Encryption & Security Standard
policies.content: All confidential customer records and PII must be encrypted using AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) must be enforced for administrative access.

requirements.requirement: AES-256 encryption mandatory for all stored customer data.
TLS 1.3 mandatory for data in transit.

policies.title: Data Retention & Erasure Policy
policies.content: Customer data and personal information must be permanently purged within 90 days following agreement termination or explicit written erasure request under GDPR/CCPA compliance.

requirements.requirement: Permanent deletion of customer data within 90 days of contract termination.

policies.title: Platform Availability & Uptime SLA Policy
policies.content: SaaS platforms and managed services must guarantee a minimum monthly SLA availability of 99.9% uptime (excluding scheduled maintenance) with credit remedies for downtime breaches.

policies.title: Contract Renewal & Termination Notice Window
policies.content: Agreement termination or non-renewal notices must be submitted in writing at least 60 days prior to the expiration of the active term to prevent automatic renewal.

requirements.requirement: Written non-renewal notice window of at least 60 days.

policies.title: Payment Terms & Late Fee Cap Standard
policies.content: Standard vendor payment terms are Net 30 days from receipt of a valid invoice. Late payment charges shall not exceed 1.5% per month on overdue balances.

requirements.requirement: Payment terms Net 30 days; late fee capped at 1.5% monthly.
